absenteeOwner.description: Only return businesses that can be run by an absentee owner.
absenteeOwner.title: Absentee-owner business

coBrokering.description: Only return listings that allow co-brokering.
coBrokering.title: Co-brokering allowed

establishedAfterYear.description: Only return businesses established after this year. Use 0 or leave empty to skip.
establishedAfterYear.title: Established after year

fetchDetails.description: Fetch each listing's detail page for the full seller write-up, financials, facilities, broker profile and photo gallery. Doubles the number of requests; leave off for the fastest, cheapest runs.
fetchDetails.title: Load full listing details

franchiseResales.description: Only return resales of existing franchise locations.
franchiseResales.title: Franchise resales

industry.description: Only return listings in this industry category. Choose 'Any industry' to search every category.
industry.title: Industry

keyword.description: Optional words to search for in the listing title and seller description, for example 'pizza' or 'HVAC'.
keyword.title: Keyword

listedWithinDays.description: Only return listings first published within this many days. Use 0 or leave empty to skip.
listedWithinDays.title: Listed within (days)

listingType.description: Filter by how the business is being sold. Business real estate options cover property-only listings.
listingType.title: Listing type

maxCashFlow.description: Only return listings reporting at most this cash flow or EBITDA.
maxCashFlow.title: Maximum cash flow (USD)

maxGrossRevenue.description: Only return listings reporting at most this annual gross revenue.
maxGrossRevenue.title: Maximum gross revenue (USD)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to save. The site exposes up to 10,000 listings per search.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Control how many rows to save and whether to load each listing's full detail page.
maxItems.title: Maximum listings

maxPrice.description: Only return listings asking at most this amount.
maxPrice.title: Maximum asking price (USD)

minCashFlow.description: Only return listings reporting at least this cash flow or EBITDA. Listings that hide financials are excluded.
minCashFlow.title: Minimum cash flow (USD)

minGrossRevenue.description: Only return listings reporting at least this annual gross revenue.
minGrossRevenue.title: Minimum gross revenue (USD)

minPrice.description: Only return listings asking at least this amount.
minPrice.sectionDescription: All filters are optional. Leave a field empty to skip that filter.
minPrice.title: Minimum asking price (USD)

noAskingPrice.description: Only return listings that do not publish an asking price.
noAskingPrice.title: No asking price published

priceReduced.description: Only return listings whose asking price was recently reduced.
priceReduced.title: Price recently reduced

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor reads BizQuest's public listing API and works without a proxy by default. Configure one only if your runs are rate-limited or blocked.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

realEstateIncluded.description: Only return listings where the business real estate is included in the asking price.
realEstateIncluded.title: Real estate included

recentlyUpdated.description: Only return listings updated recently by the seller or broker.
recentlyUpdated.title: Recently updated

sbaApproved.description: Only return listings marked as SBA loan approved.
sbaApproved.title: SBA loan approved

sellerFinancing.description: Only return listings that advertise seller financing.
sellerFinancing.title: Seller financing available

startUrls.description: Optional. Paste BizQuest search, category, state, city or individual listing URLs. When empty, the actor searches all US business listings and applies the filters below. Example: https://www.bizquest.com/businesses-for-sale-in-california-ca/
startUrls.sectionDescription: Use BizQuest URLs, structured filters, or both. Filters are applied on top of any search URL.
startUrls.title: BizQuest search or listing URLs

state.description: Only return listings in this state. Choose 'Any state' to search nationwide.
state.title: US state

withoutImage.description: Only return listings without a photo.
withoutImage.title: No photo
